changes.title: Experimental custom-rules warning
changes.text: Custom rules now explain that slider limits may evolve and earned scores are unchanged, with the warning above the scrolling controls.

changes.title: Warning layout and data protection
changes.text: Updated Android checks for the full warning, scrolling access, draft cancellation and unchanged active rules and scores.

changes.title: Experimental warning verification
changes.text: Recorded the exact warning scope and pending Android verification without changing slider limits or historical runs.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I clarified that custom rules will continue evolving throughout APD's lifetime. The warning stays after scoring is implemented; only its scoring paragraph will change.
